pool.text: Santubong was founded as a past capital of Sarawak by Sultan Pengiran Tengah.
Antimony ore was discovered at upper Sarawak river, spurring Kuching's founding.
Pengiran Indera Mahkota founded Kuching as the third capital of Sarawak.
James Brooke was appointed as the Governor of Sarawak with Rajah title.
Charles Brooke renamed the settlement to Kuching.
An epidemic broke out which was later known as Great Cholera Epidemic.
Japanese forces conquered Kuching during the Second World War.
Sir Charles Vyner Brooke ceded Sarawak to the British Crown.
Hospital Sentosa opened to provide psychiatric services for the entire state.
Kuching Port Authority was established to manage port operations.
Sarawak formed the Federation of Malaysia while retaining state capital status.
Kuching Port Authority started its operations at Tanah Puteh Port.
Kuching was granted a city status and administered by city halls.
Kuching hosted the Rainforest World Music Festival for global performers.
The airport grew rapidly with an increasing number of passengers.
Kuching Sentral main bus terminal opened in the south of the city.
A smartphone taxi-booking app called GrabTaxi was launched in Kuching.
Kuching was declared as City of Unity by One Malaysia Foundation.
Bookaroo children's literature festival started travelling to Kuching.
A study was conducted on nominating Kuching in the world heritage list.
